changelog:
♻️ Reset first routing: each new request goes to the account whose credits reset soonest, so credits that would expire unused are spent first.
📉 Credit forecast: an account's details show when its credits run out at the last 7 days' rate and how many will be left at the reset. The Accounts list flags one that runs out early.
🗝️ API keys can be limited to chosen models, a number of requests per minute and an expiry date, pick accounts by tag, and take their own routing mode.
📬 A daily usage summary by webhook, Telegram, Discord or Slack: requests, failures, credits and tokens of the last 24 hours, the busiest accounts and keys, and the accounts that need attention.
🛡️ Two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app, with ten one-time recovery codes. ADMIN_RESET_2FA=1 turns it off if you lose both.
🧵 Requests group into conversations, and a failed request can be replayed on another account or model. Request bodies are kept 30 days for this, masked and compressed.
📊 Prometheus metrics at /metrics behind a bearer token, off by default, with a ready scrape job to copy.
🌐 Proxy pool: switch each proxy off without removing it; a proxy is marked unhealthy only after three failed checks in a row, and the global and account proxies are checked too.
📈 Usage by key is a sortable table with a trend line per key. A key opens a panel with its chart, its models and accounts, its details and its limits.
⚙️ Settings is split into General, Server and Security, each with its own section menu, and the menu shows which features are on.
🧹 Log retention keeps 1 to 365 days of request and error logs, or 0 to keep them forever.
📤 Exporting accounts has quick picks (all, active, needs attention, disabled) and a preview that hides the credentials until you show them.
⌨️ Number and code fields take only what they can hold: digits in numbers and two-factor codes, the right characters in regions, machine IDs and header names, and each stops at its length limit.
✨ Charts load with skeletons in their shape, scrollbars are hidden everywhere, and the metrics token shows masked on one line.
🔧 Fixed: a failed account or global proxy counts as a proxy error in the metrics.
🔧 Fixed: errors and summaries name a key scoped to accounts and a deleted key.
🔧 Fixed: account tags on the API page are masked in privacy mode.
🔧 Fixed: the daily summary time list opens under its field instead of filling the window.
